Name: (CP) Hitme's Caroline Is Single - Rewritten
Author: Scrimbles
Description:
[b][u]Hitme's Caroline Is Single[/u][/b] mod is famous for having [b][u]a very extensive, immersive storyline.[/u][/b] However,[b] English is not Hitme's first language[/b], and the mod contains a lot of [b][u]confusing plot points, typos, and often unintentionally funny dialogue.[/u][/b]

As a resident [b][i]Pierre hater[/i][/b] and [b]Caroline lover[/b], and a frequent modder, I took it upon myself to[b][u] fully rewrite the whole script, hoping to fix inaccuracies, clear out some confusing dialogue, and to add a little more *spice* in a couple of areas.
[/u][/b]
[b][size=4]
Despite my best efforts, this mod may still contain typos or confusing elements. Please feel free to send feedback / screenshots, and I'll do my best to keep things updated![/size][/b]


[size=5][b][u]INSTALLATION:[/u][/b]
[/size][b]Hitme's original mod is required to be installed first, you can find it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21711]HERE[/url]﻿

[/b]Please make sure to read their mod page for further details.[b]
[/b]
[size=4][b]After installing Hitme's version, putting it in your 'Mods' folder, simply extract my copy over top of it. The two files 'manifest.json' and 'default.json' should be overwritten

[/b][/size]And thats it! Hopefully everything works properly from then on.

Really tiny update, fixed a typo pointed out in the comments!
